# @vllnt/convex-music

> Provider-neutral, cached music catalog as a Convex component — Spotify, Apple Music, and more behind one API.

`@vllnt/convex-music` is a publishable Convex component targeting `convex@^1.45.0`. It caches
normalized music facts — tracks, artists, and albums — in its own sandboxed tables, keyed by an
opaque provider id and cross-referenced by ISRC, each entry with an optional TTL. One typed API
spans every provider (Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, MusicBrainz, and Wikidata adapters).
The host owns auth; the component owns the factual catalog and the host keeps gameplay + editorial,
referencing catalog rows by id / ISRC. The raw cache API includes `put`, `get`, `getByIsrc`,
`invalidate`, `pruneExpired`, and `stats`. The durable catalog (artists/tracks/albums/playlists),
provider adapters, read-through fetch, the in-component import/sync engine, and an optional
tree-shakeable `./react` hooks layer (`useArtist` / `useTrack` / `useArtistImage` / `useTrackPreview`
/ `useSearchArtists` / `useSearchTracks`) are implemented;
artist-image auto-sync and multi-catalog remain planned (see the README).
`configure` persists provider credentials in the sandboxed `providerConfig` table;
the host must keep credential setup authorized and never return secrets to clients.

## For coding agents

The docs are bundled in the npm package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-music/docs/`, next to
`CHANGELOG.md`, this `llms.txt`, and the TypeScript sources in `src/`. They match the installed
version. Read them before writing code against this package.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md): Overview, installation, usage, API summary
- [API Reference](./docs/API.md): Entry points, client methods, value shapes, TTL/cache semantics, error codes
- [Changelog](./CHANGELOG.md): Version history and release notes
- [Client source](./src/client/index.ts): The `Music` class and its input types
- [Contributing](https://github.com/vllnt/convex-music/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, validation commands, release workflow (repository only)
